source_dictionary: y_j=(g^2 a)^-1 derivative of calibrated H_y[q]; continuum conjugate is exact average on prescribed I_j. Fixed outer terms are apparatus identity calibration. No improvement term or coefficient fit.
detector: Historical B2 weights recomputed by unchanged rule for W=exp(2iF). Ideal impulsive controlled-source instrument; no finite-pulse claim.
probe_definition: sine_m(z)=pi/(2L)sin(m*pi*z/L), m1,2,3; beta_left=30/L*(z/L)*(1-z/L)^4. Each L1 norm1; signed integrals1,0,1/3,1. v_j=integral_Ij g, c_g=integral_outer g/4. No quadratic probe reconstruction.
states: Vacuum, unitary kick, both K branches at t=0,.43,1.31, and all four branches from K at0,.43 observed at1.31. Complete signed insertion matrices retained; no new history-TV gate.
decision: All numerical gates plus N22 standard/refined first and second moments and complex insertion errors+reserve<=.002, covariance error+reserve<=.001, kick and conditional energy errors+1e-6<=.02*continuum energy; N20to22 observable step<=.001. Compare maximum across both N22 solves. Rare branches unresolved, not omitted.
threshold_basis: Prospective operational tolerances for fixed dimensionless L1<=1 source probes; not universal physical bounds. No inspected D1 production result informed them.
inputs: Immutable archived ground-state checkpoints identified by INPUTS.json. Refined N22 uses archived refined ground and splits each new propagation interval in two.
stop_rule: One run per registered point. Preserve failures; no fit, alternate dictionary, parameter change, retry or automatic finer size.
massive_rule: Withheld under every D1 verdict; N22 and B2 remain historical results, and P1 parent obligations remain separate.
scope: Source realization plus independent finite matrix-element tests; no exact finite-a inter-Hilbert-space equality, uniform operator bound, continuum theorem, full multihistory closure or finite switching guarantee.
